Final Formative
Units: 1. Work effectively within TVET Sector • 3. Apply OSH in a CBT&A Environment • 4. Apply ICT to facilitate in training and
assessment • 11. Design and develop Competency Based Assessment • 12. Organise and Conduct Competency Assessment
Name: ______________________ Time: 1 hour Date: ____________
Multiple Choice Questions (Tick the correct answer)
1. Why are Pre-Vocational levels (Pre-Voc 1 and Pre-Voc 2) included in the NTVQF?
a) To certify middle level managers and sub-assistant engineers
b) To allow easier access to formal TVET for poor or underprivileged groups who might not have
sufficient formal schooling
c) To replace apprenticeship training in industry
d) To register training organisations with BTEB
2. In the example of a Photocopy Machine Operator, "clear paper jams" falls under which dimension of
competency?
a) Task skills
b) Task management skills
c) Contingency management skills
d) Job/role environment skills
3. According to the hierarchy of controls, which control is always considered the control of last resort?
a) Elimination
b) Substitution
c) Administrative controls
d) Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
4. A workstation that is too high or too low, poor lighting, or a job that repeats the same movement
over and over is an example of which type of hazard?
a) Physical hazard
b) Biological hazard
c) Chemical hazard
d) Ergonomic hazard
5. Which program controls the operation of software applications and hardware, like a set of traffic
lights controls vehicles?
a) Application program
b) Operating system
c) Spreadsheet program
d) Web browser
6. In a spreadsheet (MS-Excel), which function key is used to edit the value of a cell?
a) F1
b) F2
c) F5
d) F7
7. An integrated approach to assessment design that combines knowledge, problem solving, technical
skills, attitudes and ethics, often collecting evidence from more than one unit, is called:
a) Holistic assessment design
b) Diagnostic assessment
c) Formative assessment
d) Recruitment assessment
8. Which evidence gathering tool corresponds to the "Portfolio" assessment method?
a) Task observation checklist
b) List of questions and response sheet

c) Portfolio evaluation checklist
d) Short test questions and essay
9. An assessor makes a positive judgement about a trainee because of his reputation or because they
have similar dress, speech or background. This error is called:
a) Horn effect
b) Halo effect
c) Marking down the middle
d) Failing to observe
10. When giving feedback, what ratio of positive to negative comments should an assessor aim for?
a) One positive for every negative
b) Two positives for every negative
c) Three positives for every negative
d) At least five positives for every negative
Matching: Match the items in column A with the descriptions in column B.
Column A
Ans
Column B
11. Contingency management skills
A. A tool that maps every element and its performance
criteria against appropriate assessment methods
12. Recognition of Prior Learning
B. Makes sure machinery or equipment will not start
(RPL)
and injure a worker during set-up or clean-up
13. Lockout procedure
C. Kiss - Kick - Kiss: a positive point, an area to improve,
then an encouraging statement
14. Assessment planning matrix
D. Ability to respond to irregularities, breakdowns,
imperfections and the unknown in routines
15. The feedback sandwich
E. Assessing current skills and knowledge, no matter
how, when or where the learning occurred
Short Question
16. What are the components of a competency standard?
17. What are the benefits of Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL)?

18. What are the four steps of the Hazard Management process?
19. As a worker, what three rights does the law give you for health and safety? Explain briefly.
20. Write down the rules you should follow to prevent physical hazards when using a computer.
21. Write down the correct shutdown sequence of a computer.
22. What is reasonable adjustment? Give some examples.
23. What are the stages in preparing an assessment plan?
24. When should an assessor stop an assessment?
25. What information should a good assessment record include?
